Final durable supervision receipt publication is after the final acceptance clock reading. A filesystem stall/failure during that publication is outside the recorded final elapsed boundary; do not describe this as a hard wall-clock guarantee for arbitrary storage failures.
This is offline importer verification only, not acquisition release, source service availability, anatomical validity or permission to use downloaded labels for planning/training.
